text:
Alex Chen: Quick heads-up thread: we're still getting inconsistent prune behavior across deployments. Need to define a single contract for TTL/expiration so policy authors and runtime teams stop stepping on each other.
Priya Patel: Problem: policies often set `ttl` and expect 'never' when omitted; some runtimes treat missing or 0 as immediate expiry. That's causing routes to vanish unexpectedly.
Jordan Lee: Proposed principle: policy expresses intent; runtime enforces safety and may narrow intent but must never widen (i.e., can't extend a shorter intent into permanence). Any narrowing must be recorded.
Sven Mfcller: Implementation idea: add explicit fields `intent_expiry_seconds` and `expiry_enforcement_mode: [strict|lenient]`. Default mode is lenient in legacy compat.
Nina Gomez: Ops viewpoint: we need a visible, auditable queue of pending prunes. Prefer control-plane queue for observability and RBAC, but private/on-prem customers should be allowed a local-only mode.
Alex Chen: If we allow both, define canonical behavior: control-plane-managed takes precedence when present; local-only mode is active when control-plane bundle missing or `local_control: true`.
Priya Patel: For local bundles, use signed manifests (JWT with key rotation) so control-plane intent can be verified even offline. Runtime validates signature then applies policy.
Jordan Lee: Add a `prune_preview` API so customers can run `redwood route preview --policy <id>` to see which routes would be soft-deprecated/pruned in 72h. This should mirror what control-plane will do.
Sven Mfcller: Telemetry contract: emit `route.intent_accepted`, `route.intent_clamped`, `route.intent_rejected`, `route.prune_executed`. Each event must include: policy_id, route_id, declared_ttl, effective_ttl, clamp_reason, runtime_version, deployment_mode.
Priya Patel: Also require `enforced_by` metadata for each change: either `policy-service`, `control-plane`, `local-runtime`, or `operator-override:<id>` and include operator identity.
Alex Chen: Linting rule: CI rejects ambiguous TTLs. Examples: `ttl: 0` => must include `permanent: true` or be disallowed. `ttl` absent => treated as `intent_expiry_seconds: null` (meaning indefinite) but lint should warn.
Jordan Lee: Backwards migration: plan A (safe): deploy runtime that accepts new `intent_*` fields and logs warnings but keeps legacy behavior. Plan B (enforce-new): after N weeks, new routes must use `intent_*` fields or will be rejected. Educate via console banner and CLI notices.
Nina Gomez: Emergency ops: provide an `operator_override` endpoint that can schedule immediate prune with TTL=0 for emergency, but auto-expire that override in 1 hour and require a post-mortem.
Priya Patel: API guarantees: if a route is marked `soft_deprecate` runtime will set header `X-Redwood-Route-Deprecation: soft;eta=2026-01-10T15:04:05Z` on proxied responses. Also increment a per-route `deprecation_count` metric.
Sven Mfcller: For dedicated/private customers, document how to switch to `local_control` and how to supply signing keys. Provide a `redwood-admin bundle sign` helper and a `redwood-runtime --dry-run-bundle` mode.
Jordan Lee: Testing: add unit test that simulates signed bundles, expired signatures, and mismatched keys. Add integration test that runs `route-lifecycle-sim` to exercise active->soft->prune transitions and validates emitted telemetry.
Alex Chen: Rollout strategy: feature-flag `route-expiry-v2`. Start with internal-only, then beta for orgs that opt-in, then enforced default after telemetry stable.
Priya Patel: Docs: policy schema examples, migration checklist, CLI commands, operator runbook for overrides and for recovering mistakenly-pruned routes (recreate route and run `redwood route restore --since <ts>`).
PolicyBot: Example schema for v2 intent-first policy:
```yaml
route:
  id: "sales-legacy-eu"
  match: {region: eu-west, model: "small"}
  intent_expiry_seconds: 2592000  # 30d
  soft_deprecate_window_seconds: 86400 # 1d
  expiry_enforcement_mode: "lenient"
  metadata:
    owner: "@nina"
    created_by: "policy-cli-v2"
    enforced_by: "" # filled by runtime when clamped
```
Alex Chen: Action items: Priya & Jordan draft the new schema and linter rules. Sven & Nina prototype telemetry events and signed-bundle flow. Ops to prepare emergency override playbook. We'll reconvene next Tues.
Priya Patel: I'll open a PR with schema + lint rules and a draft migration timeline today.
Jordan Lee: I'll add the preview CLI and the dry-run runtime flag to the backlog.
Nina Gomez: I'll document the signing key process for private customers and add the runbook.
Alex Chen: Thanks team. Let's keep this thread for followups. :rocket:
